# Town of Weston municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Denis Benson (Chair), Pamela Dickman, Brian Gehlich, James Linville (Vice Chair), and Kathleen Moriarty-Fitzpatrick -- a pre-September 2026 vintage
Town of Weston, Selectboard page (live): Duane Hart (Chair, seat to 2029), Jim Linville (Vice Chair, 2028), Kathleen Moriarty-Fitzpatrick (2028), Brian Gehlich (2027), and Susan Morris (2027)
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Denis Benson was re-elected to the three-year seat and a two-year seat was left vacant

Town of Weston, official Special Town Meeting Results, September 26, 2026: after Benson's departure, the special meeting elected Duane Hart to the remainder of the three-year seat (to March 2029) and Susan Morris to the remainder of the two-year seat (to March 2027); both are minted as elected. Pamela Dickman no longer sits
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Article 1 elected Wayne Granquist Moderator for the ensuing year
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kim Seymour as Weston's Town Clerk
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Kim Seymour was elected Town Clerk (one-year term, as Weston elects the office)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kim Seymour as Weston's Town Treasurer
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Kim Seymour was elected Town Treasurer (one-year term)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers
Town of Weston, Listers page: names Greg Carroll and Jeff Seymour; the third seat is printed 'VACANT'
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: the three-year lister seat 'remains vacant'; the seated listers' terms run to 2027 (Carroll) and 2028 (Seymour)

Town of Weston, Library page and the 2025 Town Report's trustees table: a ten-member board of library trustees on staggered five-year terms (the board size is derived from the report's table together with the four seats warned in 2026 -- flagged on issue #163)

Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Carrie Chalmers, Nicole Pfister, Linda Saarnijoki, and Nancy O'Connell were elected library trustees in 2026; the continuing trustees are Deborah Granquist and Joanne Prouty (2027), Tina Hartell (2028), and Malcolm Hamblett, Richard Lechthaler, and Gene Palma (2030)

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect trustees of public funds
Town of Weston, Trustees of Public Funds page: Andrew Clapp, Nicole Pfister, and Ronald Prouty (terms to 2028, 2027, and 2028)
Town of Weston, Cemeteries page: the Cemetery Commissioners are Duane Hart (2030), William Hoyt (2028), Doris Ingram (2029), Richard 'Dick' Lechthaler, and Patrick Walsh (2027), on five-year terms
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Richard Lechthaler was re-elected Cemetery Commissioner in 2026
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect constables
Town of Weston, official Town Meeting Results, March 3, 2026: Marisa Bolognese was elected Constable (one-year term)

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Weston justices of the peace: Marisa Bolognese, Carolyn L. Brosseau, Wayne G. Granquist, William 'Bill' Hoyt, and Donna Taranko-Moulton

Town of Weston, 'Justice of the Peace Results, November 5, 2024' (official town PDF): confirms the same five winners. The 2025 Town Report's JP table (Charles Goodwin, Marguerite Mason) is stale and is not used
